long_biography.plain_text:
Animal welfare supplies the clearest public focus of James Berwind's work. As a director of Spring Point Partners, he leads its Life of Riley programme, which backs community-driven solutions and broader leadership in animal protection. The programme grew from years of support for shelters and humane initiatives, including start-up funding for a Philadelphia outreach project.

Berwind helped establish Spring Point with his siblings in 2017 as a Philadelphia social-impact organisation. Its model combines investment in leaders and networks with grant-making across community change. Within that structure, he concentrates on animal welfare rather than day-to-day management of the Berwind companies, whose executive operations are led by a separate professional team.
